_readme: MEETINGS FEED — public calendar of Walton County stormwater-relevant meetings and projected plan milestones. Schema per row: {id, title, type, start (ISO8601 local, no offset), end (ISO8601 local), tz:'America/Chicago', status:'noticed'|'projected', agendaUrl, why, note}. HONESTY RULE: status 'noticed' = a real, officially-noticed meeting with a public agenda source; status 'projected' = an INFERRED milestone derived from the plan timeline that has NOT yet been officially noticed — always carry note:'[INFERRED from plan timeline]' on projected rows. Never present projected rows as scheduled fact. TO EDIT: open this file on GitHub → edit → commit to a branch → open PR → a Vercel Preview build renders your change → merge to prod. Do not add per-property dollar figures. Use 'special assessment', never 'tax'.

meetings.title: Projected: Published-notice window for the stormwater assessment program
meetings.why: Florida non-ad-valorem assessment programs require statutory published notice ahead of adoption. Plan timeline places this window in Dec 2026 so the program can be certified for the 2027 tax roll.
meetings.note: [INFERRED from plan timeline] — not officially noticed. Statutory notice requirements: see FS Ch. 197 (uniform method) and FS § 197.3632. Dates are illustrative planning targets.

meetings.title: Projected: Resolution of intent to use the uniform method (before Jan 1, 2027)
meetings.why: To use the uniform method of collection on the tax bill for a given year, a local government must adopt a resolution of intent before January 1 of that year (FS § 197.3632(3)(a)).
meetings.note: [INFERRED from plan timeline] — projected milestone. The Jan 1 deadline is statutory; the specific meeting date is illustrative and not yet noticed.

meetings.title: Projected: 2027 public hearings on the stormwater assessment roll
meetings.why: Public hearings let residents comment on the proposed special assessment methodology and the preliminary assessment roll before certification.
meetings.note: [INFERRED from plan timeline] — projected window across summer 2027; individual hearing dates will be officially noticed later.

meetings.title: Projected: Assessment roll certified to Tax Collector (by Sep 15, 2027)
meetings.why: Under the uniform method, the non-ad-valorem assessment roll must be certified to the Tax Collector by September 15 (FS § 197.3632(5)(a)) to appear on that year's combined tax bill.
meetings.note: [INFERRED from plan timeline] — the Sep 15 deadline is statutory; certification is contingent on prior adoption steps completing.

meetings.title: Projected: First stormwater program funding available (Nov 2027)
meetings.why: Combined tax bills mail in November; assessment collections begin then, providing the program's first dedicated stormwater revenue.
meetings.note: [INFERRED from plan timeline] — projected. Actual availability depends on collection timing and program adoption.
